sourceOccurrences.note: BPR6 specifies the finite exponential profile and the distinct root/global infinite-cluster thresholds, with infimum of the empty set infinity. sourceOccurrences.note: BPR6 gives the zero/monotone/linear profile bounds, row comparison, susceptibility, simultaneous finiteness and root/global threshold lower bounds. Zero off-diagonal rows imply singleton clusters and infinite thresholds even when diagonal intensities do not vanish. Finite intensity parameters and finite row bound M are explicit.

sourceOccurrences.label: Finite graph and complete graph row bounds
sourceOccurrences.locator: Named statement start lines in the pinned source: 40, 69, 83
sourceOccurrences.relationship: Source-inspected statement correspondence with scope qualifications
sourceOccurrences.note: The finite-host application bounds each rooted susceptibility using maximum degree and an upper edge probability; only non-diagonal off-host pairs must have probability zero. The complete-graph application has row (n-1)p, arbitrary diagonal probabilities, and susceptibility one at n=1. At n=0 there is no root. The examples at n=3, p=1/4 and n=2, p=1/2 illustrate the source witnesses. The frozen finite random graph article states the averaged consequence, not the full rooted source statement.
